findings.message: CAP-01 candidate: Capability export WriteRemoteObject lacks a recognized caller authorization on this path. Entry=IntellVoiceServiceStub::CreateEngineInner [entry-source=services/intell_voice_service/server/sa/intell_voice_service_stub.cpp]; possible consequence (not established): an object reference, file descriptor or service capability may leave the authorized owner [capability_exposure CWE-668]; path=((60, 'type == INTELL_VOICE_HEADSET_WAKEUP => True'), (65, 'ret != 0 => False'), (69, 'engine != nullptr => True'))

limitations: Model=oh-ipc-2026.10-v32; first-party bounded structured syntax interpretation, no external scanner execution.
Private branch pass reconstructs Tree-sitter nodes; public shared facts/schema are unchanged.

No compiler CFG, arbitrary virtual dispatch, alias analysis or full-program authorization proof. Macros are expanded only from the scan's own sources and only when unambiguous; the catalogue is never an #include resolution, and what the expander refused is counted in the macro-expansion limitation rather than assumed away.
Unmodeled callees/authorization remain evidence obligations; no findings does not establish safety.

Interface-descriptor identity is read from the class's own base clause: a comparison is counted as this transaction's guard only when the source names the interface the class implements. A comparison against another interface, or one whose identity the analysed sources do not state, is reported with that reason instead of counting as a guard or as a proven mismatch.
Descriptor consistency is separate from caller authorization; relay candidates are not exploit proofs.

IPC roots require a source-indexed class dispatcher with code, request Parcel and reply Parcel; explicit service/transport roots and Stub inner helpers are separate allowlisted entry kinds. Test/fuzz/mock path roots are excluded from product candidate analysis and counted in limitations. Entry discovery is not reachability: dispatcher-level guards and macro-conditional reachability remain obligations, not conclusions.
Entry-coverage measurements are published in the interface research report, not in this result.

Cross-service boundary coverage: 0 call(s) on a handle built by iface_cast<> in the scanned sources, 0 carrying the original caller's identity (SetCallingIdentity with a calling-token value active), 0 executing as the service. Each boundary is recorded with the identity that crossed it; no candidate is emitted from the boundary itself, and a downstream service's own guards are not read from this corpus.

Entry/dispatch coverage: 1 dispatcher(s) (0 in stub classes, 0 with a recognizable guard before dispatch), 1 binding(s) by grade {'unresolved_handler': 1}, transactions {'unresolved': 1}, unresolved dispatch {'map_found_but_never_dispatched': 1}, 0 binding(s) under a preprocessor condition. A binding is not reachability; a refused binding is unknown, not safe.
Loops are conservatively explored zero/one iterations; no induction or termination proof.

source_review.entry_dispatch: OnRemoteRequest checks the interface token and dispatches the registered transaction; interface-token equality is not caller authorization.
source_review.capability_export: CreateEngineInner writes engine->AsObject() only if the virtual factory returns zero and engine is non-null; nonzero returns before export.
source_review.permission_guard: Pinned IntellVoiceService override calls VerifySystemPermission(MANAGE_INTELLIGENT_VOICE) before HandleCreateEngine; permission failure returns nonzero. The helper checks system-app/native status and AccessTokenKit.VerifyAccessToken on IPCSkeleton.GetCallingTokenID().
source_review.secondary_guard: RegisterDeathRecipient is called before creation and independently verifies the same permission before registering the supplied callback object.
source_review.client_flow: The pinned proxy sends HDI_INTELL_VOICE_SERVICE_CREATE_ENGINE and reads the returned remote object, showing a designed client flow but not arbitrary-caller reachability.
source_review.build_context: Pinned BUILD.gn includes the Stub in the server source set and default GN argument sets intelligent_voice_framework_engine_enable=true; product configuration and built image were not verified.
source_review.sa_configuration: Pinned cfg runs the service as intell_voice and lists permissions for the SA process. This is not evidence of which callers are granted MANAGE_INTELLIGENT_VOICE.

assessment.classification: no_change; authorization is an interprocedural/virtual-callee fact outside this one-file bounded model, while CAP-01 remains an appropriate candidate pending external policy and runtime proof
